purpose: Freeze a finite seven-route prevalue review of issuer retail merchandise assortment, planogram and shelf availability, replenishment, promotion and coupon execution, markdown, omnichannel order allocation, pickup, return, exchange and restock states before any source row, formula, direction, candidate value, comparator, security price or return is read.

adjacent_mentions_only: operating scale, revenue, traffic, conversion, basket, sell-through and customer-quality KPIs
inventory aging, custody, consignment and channel sell-through
payment authorization, settlement, dispute and reserve
digital advertising campaign delivery and attribution
freight, parcel, last-mile delivery and return claims

requirements: lawful public or licensed point-in-time source with first-available, correction, supersession, assortment-version, planogram-version, promotion-rule and order-state timestamps mapped to accepted trading sessions

stable issuer, listed-parent, privacy-safe store or fulfillment node, channel, product family, SKU token, shelf location, assortment, planogram, replenishment task, promotion, offer, coupon, order line, reservation, pick, pickup, return, exchange and restock identities without current-state projection

complete 2019-2023 applicable denominators including listed, ranged, shelved, unavailable, replenishment-requested, allocated, picked, cancelled and withdrawn merchandise; eligible, activated, applied, redeemed, voided and expired offers; created, reserved, fulfilled, picked up, cancelled, returned, exchanged, rejected, refunded and restocked order lines

explicit missing, suppressed, corrected, reversed, failed, pending and genuine-zero semantics plus item, unit, price-rule, split-order, partial-fulfillment, return-disposition and inventory-conservation reconciliation without filling uncovered stores, products, campaigns, baskets or orders with zero

no customer or employee identity, payment credential or token, precise customer location, CCTV or device trace, personalized price or recommendation profile, supplier commercial term, unreleased promotion strategy, security control, source code, vulnerability or trade-secret detail

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: retail_assortment_range_planogram_shelf_assignment_availability_stockout_replenishment_restock_withdrawal_and_store_execution_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time source preserves issuer, privacy-safe store and product identities; assortment and planogram versions; shelf assignment; on-shelf availability; stockout detection; replenishment request, allocation, completion and cancellation; withdrawal; corrections; and the complete applicable denominator.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: retail_promotion_offer_coupon_markdown_eligibility_activation_application_redemption_void_expiration_makegood_and_settlement_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a lawful point-in-time promotion history linking rule versions, eligible merchandise and channels, activation, application, redemption, void, reversal, expiry, makegood and settlement while preserving failed, pending and structurally inapplicable denominators without customer-level or proprietary pricing data.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: retail_omnichannel_order_line_reservation_allocation_pick_pack_store_pickup_cancellation_return_exchange_refund_disposition_and_restock_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted privacy-safe source preserves the retail order-line state from reservation and inventory allocation through pick, pack, store pickup or handoff, partial cancellation, return, exchange, refund disposition and restock with complete line, unit, failure, pending and correction conservation.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: sales_revenue_gmv_same_store_sales_traffic_conversion_basket_size_gross_margin_markdown_stockout_return_or_promotion_uplift_kpi_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign168 and Campaign170 already freeze operating-scale, adoption, traffic, conversion and customer-quality KPI mechanisms; aggregate levels and rates do not preserve merchandise, planogram, offer-rule, order-line and return-disposition transitions.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: inventory_loyalty_payment_advertising_freight_delivery_claim_or_customer_support_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign195, 196, 197, 199, 207 and 209 govern payment, inventory, loyalty, support, advertising and logistics identities and clocks. None can be relabelled as a complete retail shelf-execution, promotion-rule and omnichannel-order lifecycle.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: accounting_revenue_inventory_refund_liability_balance_store_sku_master_current_catalog_or_latest_price_snapshot_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Accounting balances and current store, SKU, catalog or price snapshots use different identities and availability clocks and cannot reconstruct historical assortment, shelf availability, replenishment, promotion application, partial fulfillment, return disposition and restock events.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: retailer_store_region_channel_category_brand_sku_shelf_campaign_offer_coupon_order_customer_cohort_direction_threshold_age_window_subset_weight_interaction_combination_or_model_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Selecting a retailer, store, region, channel, category, brand, SKU, shelf, campaign, offer, coupon, order or customer cohort, direction, threshold, age, window, subset, weight, interaction or model before complete lawful base histories are admitted would multiply hypotheses and exploit issuer, store, product, campaign and order survivorship.

scientific_interpretation: Retail shelf execution, promotion-rule state and omnichannel order-line disposition are economically distinct from generic inventory, payments, loyalty, advertising, logistics and operating KPI records, but distinction alone does not admit a factor. The absent complete lawful point-in-time privacy-safe retail operating lifecycle source is the binding gate.
next_action: Bind all seven routes and every Campaign213 infrastructure failure into one append-only ledger, publish terminal prevalue evidence, and authorize a genuinely different Campaign214 domain.
